description: Land Acquisition - Advance Tracing Nos. Ma/LGG/2010/85 and Ma/LGG/2013/380 of Guruwela, Laggala Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations for acquisition for a public purpose. While a government minister is named, the notice is solely about land matters and does not contain any information about government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities. The content fits perfectly within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related matters.
